description: Defines the inspection sections used to summarize the materialized knowledge base generated after DL reasoning.

kb_statistics.name: Knowledge Base Statistics
kb_statistics.description: General quantitative overview of the materialized knowledge base.

classes_count.help: Counts the OWL classes available in the materialized knowledge base.

individuals_count.help: Counts the named individuals instantiated in the materialized knowledge base.

object_properties_count.help: Counts the object properties used to represent relationships between individuals.

data_properties_count.help: Counts the data properties used to associate individuals with literal values.

annotation_properties_count.help: Counts annotation properties used for labels, comments, descriptions, and metadata.

triples_count.help: Counts the RDF triples in the materialized OWL file.

materialization_delta.name: Materialization Delta
materialization_delta.description: Comparison between the consistent KB before reasoning and the materialized KB after reasoning.

new_triples_count.help: Counts how many RDF triples were added after DL materialization.

new_type_assertions.help: Lists new rdf:type assertions inferred for individuals.

new_object_property_assertions.help: Lists new relationships inferred between individuals through object properties.

new_data_property_assertions.help: Lists new literal values inferred through data properties.

alert_individuals.name: Alert Individuals
alert_individuals.description: Individuals directly related to the Wazuh alert and their semantic assertions.

include_incoming_relations.help: Includes relations where another individual points to the alert individual.

include_outgoing_relations.help: Includes relations where the alert individual points to another individual.

include_data_properties.help: Includes literal values associated with the alert individual, such as IDs, IPs, users, timestamps, or descriptions.

include_types.help: Includes OWL classes assigned to the alert individual, including inferred classes.

logical_axioms.name: Logical Axioms Used by the Reasoner
logical_axioms.description: Summary of the ontology axioms that may have contributed to deductive inference.

subclass_axioms.help: Lists class hierarchy axioms where one class is declared as a subclass of another.

equivalent_class_axioms.help: Lists class equivalence axioms that allow the reasoner to classify individuals or classes as semantically equivalent.

disjoint_class_axioms.help: Lists disjointness axioms used to detect incompatible class memberships.

inverse_properties.help: Lists object properties declared as inverses, allowing the reasoner to infer relations in the opposite direction.

transitive_properties.help: Lists transitive properties, where chains of relations can imply additional indirect relations.

symmetric_properties.help: Lists symmetric properties, where a relation from A to B implies the same relation from B to A.

functional_properties.help: Lists functional properties, where an individual can have at most one value for that property.

domain_axioms.help: Lists property domain axioms that allow the reasoner to infer the class of a subject using a property.

range_axioms.help: Lists property range axioms that allow the reasoner to infer the class of an object using a property.

existential_restrictions.help: Lists someValuesFrom restrictions, indicating that class membership requires the existence of at least one related value through a property.

universal_restrictions.help: Lists only restrictions, indicating that all values of a property must belong to a given class.

cardinality_restrictions.help: Lists min, max, or exact cardinality restrictions over properties.
